QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Heavy Is The Crown
QuestInfo.0: Those keys were worthless. Talk to Violetta about other options.
QuestInfo.1: Turns out the only key you needed was Violetta's TERRIFYING STRENGTH. Then she pretended to be weak and demanded you carry her. Why is this mushroom so heavy?!
QuestInfo.2: You gave Violetta a piggyback ride all the way to the Banquet Hall. She was impossibly heavy, and now you have a backache.
